final: WITH counts AS (SELECT p.player_id, COUNT(ma.rowid) AS award_count FROM player AS p LEFT JOIN manager_award AS ma ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total FROM counts) SELECT c.player_id, c.award_count, c.award_count * 1.0 / t.total AS fraction FROM counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL AND t.total <> 0 ORDER BY fraction IS NULL, fraction DESC LIMIT 10
